create_force_refresh_endpoint: create a force refresh endpoint for HuggingFace dataset processing jobs with configurable input type and priority
run_force_refresh_dataset: run a force refresh job on a HuggingFace dataset with specified priority and difficulty levels
run_force_refresh_config: run a force refresh job on a HuggingFace dataset config with optional bonus difficulty for large datasets
run_force_refresh_split: run a force refresh job on a HuggingFace dataset split with authentication and revision validation
review_force_refresh_endpoint: review the force refresh endpoint that queues processing jobs with difficulty scaling for large datasets
